name: openai-audio
description: OpenAI audio: text to speech saved as audio files, transcription and translation to English from files or URLs

nodes.title: Text to speech
nodes.description: Turn text (up to 4096 characters) into speech and save the audio file in OPENAI_AUDIO_OUTPUT_DIR (billed per character or token)

voice.description: alloy, ash, ballad, coral, echo, fable, onyx, nova, sage, shimmer, verse, marin or cedar (or a custom voice id)

instructions.description: Tone, accent or style instructions (gpt-4o-mini-tts only)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Transcribe audio
nodes.description: Transcribe audio to text in its own language (https URL or a file inside OPENAI_AUDIO_UPLOAD_DIR; billed per minute of audio)

file.description: Audio file up to 25 MB (flac, mp3, mp4, mpeg, mpga, m4a, ogg, wav, webm) (an https URL, or an absolute path inside the plugin's upload directory)

model.description: gpt-4o-mini-transcribe, gpt-4o-transcribe, gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize, gpt-transcribe or whisper-1

language.description: ISO-639-1 language of the audio, e.g. id; improves accuracy and latency

prompt.description: Text to guide style or vocabulary (same language as the audio; English for translations)

response_format.description: json (default); gpt-4o(-mini)-transcribe support json only; srt, vtt and verbose_json are whisper-1; diarized_json is gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize

timestamp_granularities.description: word and/or segment timestamps (whisper-1 with verbose_json)

chunking_strategy.description: auto: split the audio on silence first (required by the diarize model for audio over 30 s)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Translate audio to English
nodes.description: Transcribe audio in any supported language into English text (https URL or a file inside OPENAI_AUDIO_UPLOAD_DIR; whisper-1, billed per minute)

file.description: Audio file up to 25 MB (flac, mp3, mp4, mpeg, mpga, m4a, ogg, wav, webm) (an https URL, or an absolute path inside the plugin's upload directory)

prompt.description: Text to guide style or vocabulary (same language as the audio; English for translations)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: List models
nodes.description: List the models the key can use (look for tts-*, *-transcribe and whisper-1)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: OpenAI API request
nodes.description: Call any OpenAI API endpoint that has no dedicated operation, e.g. path "/models". Only the API's own host is allowed.

path.description: Path relative to the API base, starting with "/", e.g. "/models"

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
